name: PhysioNet/CinC Challenge 2020: Classification of 12-lead ECGs
description: PhysioNet/Computing in Cardiology (CinC) Challenge 2020 is a multi-center electrocardiogram benchmark comprising 43,101 12-lead clinical ECG recordings aggregated from 6 diverse hospital and clinical sources worldwide. Recordings are annotated with SNOMED-CT clinical diagnostic codes to advance automated detection of cardiac arrhythmias and heart conditions.
